headline: Election day: Berlin & MV polls open 08–18; BVB 1–0 Stuttgart takes table lead; Rapuncel GitHub infostealer; Moscow drone strike.

stories.title: Election day: Berlin & MV polls open 08–18 — Linke–CDU photo finish; SPD–AfD duel in Schwerin

facts.text: Wahllokale open 08:00–18:00 Sunday in Berlin (~2.5M eligible) and Mecklenburg-Vorpommern (~1.3M); first-time 16-/17-year-old franchise in both (FAZ / SWP dpa).
Berlin: CDU–SPD Senate majority looks gone; only Dreierbündnisse viable (CDU–SPD–Grüne or Linke–SPD–Grüne). Latest polls put Linke and CDU ~20–23%; AfD/Grüne next; SPD ~10–15% (FAZ).
Spitzen: CDU Finance Senator Stefan Evers (after Wegner dropped); Linke’s Elif Eralp — housing/rents dominate framing (FAZ).
MV: SPD (Schwesig) vs AfD (Holm) still within error — recent polls AfD ~36–38% / SPD ~33–37%; other parties excluded AfD coalitions; first projections ~18:00 (FAZ / ZDF).
Federal stake: results framed as a Merz/CDU stress test after Saxony-Anhalt; Merz invited CDU Präsidium to Adenauer-Haus Sunday evening (SWP).
Official counts: Berlin continuous at wahlen-berlin.de (provisional ~01:30 Mon); MV LAiV from ~19:00 (wahlen-berlin / LAiV).

stories.whyItMatters: Evening’s campaign-close briefing is now election day — ballots, not polls, decide two of Germany’s closest Land races and feed the Bund debate.

stories.title: Russia: ‘massive’ Ukrainian drone wave hits Moscow region — 2 dead; airports restricted

facts.text: Moscow region governor Vorobyev: ≥2 killed, 6 injured overnight; claims 249 drones shot down; fires in residential houses + warehouse; Sofyino building hit; elderly man killed in Orekhovo-Zuevo (BBC).
Mayor Sobyanin: oil-refinery facility damaged; claims 450 drones toward Moscow downed; Sheremetyevo temporary restrictions, Vnukovo arrivals/departures halted (BBC).
Ukraine side same window: mother + 2 children killed in Fastiv (Kyiv region); 4 killed by drone hitting a car in Sumy — officials Tkachenko / Hryhorov (BBC).

stories.whyItMatters: Both sides keep hitting energy/logistics hubs despite Trump’s claim of a mutual pause — overnight’s Moscow wave is the largest claimed against the capital in recent days.

stories.title: Rapuncel: SEO fake GitHub repos push signed-driver EDR killer + credential stealer

facts.text: LastPass + Delphos Labs flag “Rapuncel”: SEO-poisoned fake GitHub repos impersonating LastPass Authenticator and ≥39 other brands; ZIP payloads up to ~148MB (heise / BleepingComputer).
Chain: renamed Microsoft vsdbg.exe sideloads vsdbg.dll → Alinubx.sys (HW-Compatibility–signed, as nvfsflt64.sys) kills 145 AV/EDR procs via KernelMode opens (BleepingComputer).
Then steals browser creds (app-bound Chrome/Edge bypass), crypto wallets, Discord/Steam/Telegram sessions, Windows creds, seed docs, screenshots; persists as a service (heise / BC).
Driver not on Microsoft’s vulnerable-driver blocklist at disclosure; researchers assess Rapuncel as a BoryptGrab variant (heise).

stories.whyItMatters: Trust in GitHub search hits + Microsoft-signed drivers is the exploit surface — download only from official vendor sites.

stories.title: Iran conveys talks conditions via Qatar; Saudi coalition says Houthi missile toward Riyadh foiled

facts.text: Iran security official Mohsen Rezaei tells Al Jazeera Tehran sent White House conditions via Qatari mediators: end war on all fronts, release frozen assets, lift US naval blockade on Iranian ports (Al Jazeera live).
Same liveblog: Saudi-led coalition says it foiled a Houthi ballistic missile aimed at Riyadh (Al Jazeera / AFP wires in blog).

stories.whyItMatters: Diplomacy track and regional spillover are moving in parallel on a Sunday morning already dominated by German elections.
